usageNotes: Returns the list of sub-commands available under a specific QEMU VM snapshot (e.g., 'config' and 'rollback'). Use this as a discovery step to confirm which actions are exposed before calling a snapshot sub-resource. The snapshot must already exist on the specified node; the snapname must match exactly (case-sensitive, pve-configid format).

examples.summary: List available sub-commands for a snapshot named 'pre-upgrade' on VM 101

tips: The response is an index array of child links (e.g., 'config', 'rollback') — not snapshot content itself. Call the child endpoints to read config or perform a rollback.
snapname follows pve-configid rules: alphanumeric plus hyphens/underscores, max 40 characters, no spaces.
This endpoint returns HTTP 500/not-found if the snapshot does not exist; use list_nodes_node_qemu_vmid_snapshot to enumerate valid snapnames first.
Accessible by all authenticated users (no VM.Snapshot privilege required), but child operations like rollback will enforce their own privilege checks.
